policy: Status records public release metadata only, never data availability at an endpoint or completed downloads. Upcoming, results-only, and unverified releases are blocked until an adapter schema and rights notice are reviewed.

releases.note: Enabled for CIRCLE queries with TOP <= 2000. The archive announced temporary DR4 preparation downtime; published status does not assert current endpoint uptime.

releases.access: ESA Gaia Archive; public date announced for 2026-12-02 12:00 CET
releases.note: Not enabled and not ingested. Re-check the schema, archive service, and data licence after release; no DR4 scientific rows are fabricated.

releases.access: EDD kallcf4 / Table 2; operator-supplied bounded local export
releases.note: The EDD page listed 55,874 rows on the check date. This adapter intentionally caps local input at 2,000 rows and never downloads the full catalogue.

releases.access: Published tables and VizieR J/AJ/144/4; bounded local export
releases.note: The original compilation is not a live API. Local column mappings must preserve the row's literature provenance.

releases.access: DESI public DR1 directory; bounded local export
releases.note: Official release overview lists DR1 and EDR bulk data. FITS/Parquet require explicit external conversion to the supported tabular formats.

releases.access: DESI DR2 papers and supporting result products
releases.note: The official releases overview did not advertise a DR2 bulk spectroscopic release on the check date. No DR2 bulk adapter is enabled.

releases.access: ESA Euclid science archive; bounded local export
releases.note: Published 2026-11-12 under CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO. Column names vary by product; release-specific mappings are mandatory.

releases.access: Planck Legacy Archive parameter tables; bounded local table
releases.note: Parameter-table adapter only; no maps, likelihood grids, or chains are downloaded.

releases.access: MAST Jdaviz v0.1 parameters endpoint for one PUBLIC data URI
releases.note: Only public metadata is enabled. Product-specific rights and the exclusive-access period are checked per response.

releases.access: GWOSC API v2 cumulative GWTC event list and default parameter metadata
releases.note: At most 25 event rows and one bounded metadata page. Event version and parameter source are retained; no strain/posterior files are fetched.
